Method of Attack: Exploiting a memory corruption vulnerability (CVE-2023-43641) to execute arbitrary code
Impacted Systems: Linux systems running the GNOME desktop environment
Attack Vector: Malicious actors lure a victim into clicking a malevolent link and downloading a .cue file, which is then automatically scanned by Tracker Miners
Indicators of Compromise: Out-of-bounds array access within the track_set_index function in libcue
